build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO2 convolution module for spherical harmonic features with configurable m orders and radial weights
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO2 linear layer that performs equivariant linear transforms on spherical harmonic coefficients
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build a block-diagonal SO2 convolution module for faster GEMM-based equivariant transforms on m order features
convert_convert_so2_conv1: convert an existing SO2_Convolution with radial weights to the optimized SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock module
convert_convert_so2_conv2: convert an existing SO2_Convolution with internal weights to the optimized SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock module
